description: Send a NON-BINDING inquiry to the Amrusch family on behalf of the guest. Only use this when the guest has explicitly agreed to send it and provided their name and email address. The guest receives an email with a confirmation link; the family only sees the inquiry after the guest confirms. No booking and no payment is made.

apartment_type.description: a = Studio, b = Apartment with bedroom, c = Family apartment (optional)

guest_consent.description: Must be true: the guest has explicitly asked you to send this inquiry

language.description: Language of the guest (for links and emails). Default: en

message.description: Questions or wishes of the guest, in their own words

pets.description: Guest would like to bring a pet (only by arrangement)

name: send_inquiry
title: Send a non-binding inquiry
